propositions: Empty local assignee is resolved to empty string by outbound_differ, which reaches DC transport's update_issue with assignee=""
DC transport forwards empty string verbatim to pycontribs JIRA.assign_issue instead of routing it through unassign_issue
pycontribs JIRA._get_user_id does not treat empty string as unassign sentinel; it calls search_users("") which either raises JIRAError or assigns an arbitrary user
Cloud transport routes empty/None assignee through unassign_issue; DC transport never received this fix despite identical bug (85a1)
Empty assignee must map to None in DC transport._assign before calling assign_issue to generate correct unassign payload {"name": null}
